title: Special Potatoes
description: This is a Minecraft Forge mod for 1.7.10 that adds a wide range of unique potatoes.
body:
![POTATOES](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6926c9d34c73a6b83d070f72381257ddaa28d166.png)

Discover the unique abilities of these 7 special potatoes. All recipes use a Baked Potato as the core ingredient!

Miner's Potato (Patata Minera) Effect: Perfect for deep cave exploration. Grants Night Vision and Haste, allowing you to clear out ores faster than ever.

Fire Potato (Patata Ígnea) Effect: Embrace the heat. Grants Fire Resistance and instantly extinguishes you if you are burning, making it the perfect snack for surviving the Nether's lava lakes.

Bouncy Potato (Patata Rebotadora) Effect: Defy gravity! Gives you a massive Jump Boost and Jump height, while the feathers provide a Slow Falling feel to survive those big leaps.

Iron Potato (Patata de Hierro) Effect: Become a tank. Provides a significant Resistance buff and extra Absorption hearts to withstand heavy damage.

Creeper Potato (Patata Creeper) Effect: A volatile snack! Eating this will trigger a controlled explosion at your location (or give you explosive powers), but handle with care!

Oceanic Potato (Patata Oceánica) Effect: Master the seas. Grants Water Breathing and Swift Swim (Dolphin's Grace style), making underwater temples a breeze.

King Potato (Patata Suprema) Effect: The ultimate meal. Combining the strength of iron with the luxury of gold, this potato grants Regeneration, Resistance, and Fire Resistance. Truly fit for royalty.
